description: This file contains helper functions and commands for managing and interacting with the ClawDock environment, a Docker-based setup for the OpenClaw project. It includes configuration handling, container management, device pairing, dashboard access, and various utility commands.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Outputs styled command text in green and bold.

methods.name: _cmd
methods.description: Outputs inline command text in green and bold.

methods.name: _clawdock_filter_warnings
methods.description: Filters out warning and timing lines from command output.

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string value.

methods.name: _clawdock_mask_value
methods.description: Redacts sensitive values based on length, indicated with placeholders.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads the ClawDock config directory from file.

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures that the CLAWDOCK_DIR environment variable is set and valid, prompting for user input if needed.

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Wrapper to run Docker Compose commands using the detected environment.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the OpenClaw gateway token from the environment file.
